name: HIPAA (US)
description: Tags Clampd rules to HIPAA Privacy + Security Rule controls. Adds the 18 HIPAA-defined PHI identifiers as protected entities. Surfaces a HIPAA-aligned audit view on the dashboard. NOT a substitute for a real HIPAA audit — provides detection coverage for AI agents handling PHI.

demo_agents.name: hipaa-demo
demo_agents.description: Throwaway demo agent for learning HIPAA detection. NOT a production HIPAA-compliant config — real PHI handling needs a signed BAA with your provider, audit logging configured, and your full risk assessment.

policy_templates.description: Block any LLM output containing PHI patterns from being sent to non-allowlisted external destinations. Aligns with HIPAA §164.502(b) minimum necessary.
policy_templates.cedar_template: forbid(principal, action == Action::"net.http.outbound", resource) when { context.pii_in_response == true && !(resource.host in {{baa_allowlist}}) };

parameters.name: baa_allowlist
parameters.description: Hostnames covered by signed BAAs. Restrict to ONLY these.

policy_templates.description: Require detailed audit logging on any agent in a HIPAA scope. Aligns with HIPAA §164.312(b).
policy_templates.cedar_template: forbid(principal, action == Action::"llm.input.write", resource) when { context.scan_layers_skipped contains "shadow" };

false_positives.scenario: A medical research agent legitimately processes de-identified PHI (per HIPAA §164.514) — the bundle still flags terms like 'diagnosis' or 'ICD-10'.
false_positives.remediation: Tag the agent with 'deidentified-research' and add an applies_to_tags exclusion. Verify the de-identification was done properly per Safe Harbor or Expert Determination.
